issue.title: docs(logs): document unified CLI logs DEBUG-267
issue.body:
## Problem

The unified CLI logs commands need a public guide. The existing SQL guide also says the CLI cannot query hosted ClickHouse logs, which is only true for v2.

## Fix

Add **Logs in the CLI** to the Observability navigation and overview cards. Cover local and remote queries, filters and time ranges, interactive versus JSON output, exports, SQL, command options, migration, and troubleshooting.

Include screenshots of the explorer and full record details using demo local logs. Keep the v2 CLI reference unchanged and update links from the existing logs and SQL guides.

Merge after the CLI version with unified logs is released. Tracks [DEBUG-267](https://linear.app/supabase/issue/DEBUG-267) and [DEBUG-268](https://linear.app/supabase/issue/DEBUG-268).

## How to test

Open `/docs/guides/observability/cli-logs` in the preview. Check the section order, images, option tables, and links from Observability, Logs in Studio, and Query logs with SQL.

Local examples were verified using the CLI PR build and retained log fixtures. Hosted examples were checked against the implementation but were not rerun against a live project for this docs change.

## Screenshots

Explorer showing demo local logs:

![Interactive log explorer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/supabase/supabase/0f47956edf/apps/docs/public/img/guides/observability/cli-logs/explorer.jpg)

Full selected record:

![Full log details](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/supabase/supabase/0f47956edf/apps/docs/public/img/guides/observability/cli-logs/details.jpg)

issue.title: feat(studio): one click attribute filters in the unified logs overview panel
issue.body: ## Problem Filtering via properties in the Overview tab of Unified Logs had a couple of clicks to it. ## Solution Attribute rows now expose equals and not-equals directly, through one shared code path. - **Hover devices** (`(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` above `md`): hovering or keyboard-focusing a row reveals borderless icon buttons at its right edge — equals, not equals, copy — following the same reveal pattern as the "Only" button on the sidebar filters. The value fades out behind them so nothing is occluded or reflowed. - **Touch devices and small viewports**: unchanged dropdown, now listing "Filter: equals", "Filter: not equals" and "Copy <attribute>" instead of the single "Add filter". - Only rows that can actually be filtered get filter actions; everything else gets copy alone. | Before | After | |--------|--------| | | | ## Review instructions 1. Open the preview, go to a project's Logs, and click a log row to open the detail dock on the Overview tab. 2. Hover a filterable row (Path, Method, Status, or any attribute). Equals, not-equals and copy buttons fade in at the right edge; the value fades out. Tab into them to check the focus rings and tooltips. 3. Click the equals button on Path. The filter appears in the filter bar and the log list updates. Do the same with not-equals on another row and confirm the chip uses `<>`. 4. Hover a row that can't be filtered (for example Host or Client). Only the copy button appears, and no filter action is offered. 5. Apply the same filter twice — no duplicate chip. Then apply the opposite operator on that column — the chip's operator is replaced rather than mixed. 6. Narrow the window below 768px (or use a touch device). The hover buttons disappear and clicking a row opens the dropdown with "Filter: equals", "Filter: not equals" and "Copy <attribute>".
